update_rule: Route Guardian v14 opens the current app only after the user presses Open Latest App. Current v10 writes current-before-last-good as pmp-current-inner-cleanbug-rgcontrols-v10.html#control and loads route button v4. The Continuous Run Dashboard button now opens pmp-continuous-run-dashboard-compressed-v5.html inside the current app frame instead of navigating the whole top browser page. Dashboard v5 keeps v10 route normalization and uses the in-app visual shape with Launcher/Resident pills, compact stat boxes, smaller controls, bottom nav, and no pointless bottom status tap. This does not remove gates, weaken free-only locks, start Packet 1.5, enable autonomous paid execution, authorize merging, prove hook validation, real app proof, current-clean, frozen, or best-in-world.
